title: Quick Korean Perilla-Leaf-Kkaennip Banchan
description: A refreshing and easy-to-make Korean banchan dish featuring perilla leaves, perfect for a quick snack or side dish.
instructions: Hull and tear the perilla leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the perilla leaves in cold water, then drain well.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the green chili flakes and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the perilla leaves, sugar, soy sauce, and water to the skillet.
Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes, until the perilla leaves are slightly wilted.
Season with red pepper flakes to taste, if desired.
Transfer the perilla mixture to a serving dish.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.
